defs.def: a flat board, made of wood, metal, glass, etc., fixed to the wall or forming part of a cupboard/closet, bookcase, etc., for things to be placed on （固定在墙上的或橱柜、书架等的）架子，搁板

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

ex.s: The shelves in most supermarkets are full of family-size this and multi-buy that.
Skilled at putting up shelves and piecing together furniture, she never pays someone else to do a job she can do herself.
ex.t: 她擅长安装置物架和组装家具，自己能做的活从不花钱请别人做。

ex.s: He knew every book in the store and would always pick the perfect one for us from a dusty shelf.
ex.t: 他认识店里的每一本书，总是能从满是灰尘的书架上为我们挑出最完美的那一本。

ex.s: After out the assistant, he asked to see an expensive-looking suit on an upper shelf.
ex.t: 赶走店员后，他要求看货架高处一套看起来很昂贵的西装。

defs.def: a thing shaped like a shelf, especially a piece of rock sticking out from a cliff or from the edge of a mass of land under the sea （悬崖上或海底）突出的岩石；陆架；陆棚

ex.s: Two hours before my husband came back home from another job interview, my daughter climbed up to grab a glass vase from a high shelf.
ex.t: 在丈夫从另一次面试回家两小时前女儿爬上去从高架上抓了一个玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: Samuel, the tallest boy in our class, ______ easily reach the books on the top shelf.
ex.t: 在20世纪50年代的美国，大多数家里只有一部电话，无线电话当时还没有____。

defs.def: not wanted by anyone; not used （无用而）闲置的；搁置的

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．

defs.def: considered to be too old to get married 尤指妇女

ex.s: “Eudora is nine years old and has my permission to read any book she wants from the shelves, children or adults,” Mother said.
ex.t: "Eudora九岁了，我允许她阅读书架上任何她想读的书，无论是儿童读物还是成人读物，"妈妈说。
